objectives.statement: Distinguish markers for uncertainty, inference, shared assumption, and reported or uncertain source.
Choose explicit opinion frames and informal approximation markers with suitable register.
Place stance markers naturally in Norwegian main clauses and avoid overloaded stacking.

notes: High-risk stance topic. Keep as a standalone lesson because it teaches speaker commitment and source of information: uncertainty, inference, shared assumption, reported/uncertain source, explicit opinion framing, and informal approximation. Do not turn this into a broad pragmatic-marker lesson; advanced_pragmatics handles whole-utterance social effects and topic movement. Warn against stacking too many markers and against using liksom in professional writing.
